observations: fabro-febd's original failure mode is already mitigated: the three graph-render tests now skip via render_graph_subprocess_available() when target/debug/fabro is absent, so the gate no longer fails — but the seed's preferred fix (a), gate building fabro-cli when fabro-server is touched, is unimplemented, so I claimed it as real work with a brief focused on closing that gap.

The renderer binary build added ~9 minutes cold to a fabro-server-only gate — acceptable per the seed, but future seeds touching fabro-server in a hot loop may want `cargo build` cache priming or the test-support builder route (fix direction c) if tester timeouts appear.
